card.name: Modal verbs before something appears
card.fires_on: The word 'can' or 'will' right after a named adverse event or a software action, where the next word is a verb like occur or pop up. Also a few nearby words like 'window' or 'development' in similar sentences.

modes.label: Warning-section 'can occur'
modes.description: 'can' after a named serious condition in a warnings section, leading into 'occur'.
modes.example: Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML), including fatal PML,<< can>> occur in patients receiving rituximab

modes.label: Software 'will' appears
modes.description: 'window' or 'will' in software instructions describing something that pops up or is shown.
modes.example: A<< window>> will pop up with several selections on a

card.writes: It leans against words for appearing or disappearing, such as 'disappear' and 'appearing' in Chinese and English, but the effect is weak and unclear.
card.plain: It marks the small word 'can' or 'will' just before a sentence says that something will occur or show up.
